title: Scenario A (P1 Critical - Baby & Unconscious Elder)
message: Solani aqueduct ke paas paani 6ft ho gaya hai, dadi behosh hai aur chhota baby bhi hai chhat par, jaldi aao please!

title: Scenario B (P1 Critical - Ground Floor Trapped & Rising Water)
message: Sector 4 me ground floor kamre me 2 log fas gaye hain darwaza jam ho gaya hai, paani 5 feet badh gaya hai!

title: Scenario C (P2 High - Pregnant Woman Near Shiv Mandir)
message: Civil Lines near shiv mandir 4 log hain, ek pregnant aurat hai jinki delivery hone wali hai, boat dispatch karo.

title: Scenario D (P3 Medium - Stranded but Safe on High Ground)
message: Ramnagar brij bridge ke paas 6 log chhat par surakshit hain, pani 3ft hai road par, dry food and water kit chahiye.

title: Scenario E (P4 Low - Minor Road Waterlogging)
message: Nehru nagar road par 1 foot waterlogging hai, gari nikalne me dikkat ho rahi hai.
